title: Place an order through a site's API
prompt: Order 2 of the Stoneware Kettle from {{site:shop.bench.test}}/ for delivery to me (email: me@example.com). The site's ordering page explains how to place an order. Tell me the order number.
notes: Graded by what the fake shop received: exactly one POST with SKU, quantity and email (a duplicate order fails), and the order number from its reply.
